identity.title: CO emission tracing a warp or radial flow within ≲100 au in the HD 100546 protoplanetary disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: The self-calibrated and phase-corrected measurement set, produced as described in Paper I, is used in these analyses.
In this work we revisit the HD 100546 ALMA Cycle 0 data and conduct a deeper analysis of the spatially and spectrally resolved $^{12}$CO $\mathrm{J}=3-2$ emission.

findings_qualitative.value: Emission is detected down to ~16 au radius (8 au for inclination 30 deg); the CO emitting surface is relatively flat.

claims.hypothesis: Is the CO velocity field Keplerian with a single inclination and P.A.?
claims.experiment: Fit flat and flared Keplerian models to the first-moment map
claims.result: Residuals reach ~7 dv in the inner disk
claims.finding: A purely Keplerian model with universal geometry does not describe the gas

evidence.quote: we uncover significant residuals with a peak of $\approx7\delta v$

claims.hypothesis: A misaligned inner gas disk explains the residuals
claims.result: Peak residual reduced to <3 dv with nearly edge-on inner disk almost orthogonal in P.A.
claims.finding: A twisted warp within ~100 au fits best but conflicts with dust observations

evidence.quote: reduces the residuals to $< 3\delta v$

claims.hypothesis: Fast radial flows explain the kinematics
claims.result: Residuals of ~4 dv with near free-fall inflow inside ~50 au

evidence.quote: Hence, the model including a radial velocity component only does not reproduce the data as well as that including a twisted and misaligned inner gas disk.

why_this_method.value: Simple toy models because residuals are about the beam size

evidence.quote: Because the residuals are of the order of the size of the synthesised beam, a simple toy prescription for the warp is used.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radial flow considered as alternative to warp; fits worse

evidence.quote: However, the radial flow model does not reproduce the velocity structure as well as the warped disk

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution insufficient; higher resolution (~10 au) data needed

evidence.quote: Molecular emission data at a higher spatial resolution (of order 10 au) are required to further constrain the kinematics within $\lesssim 100$ au.
Note that this analysis will not address the asymmetry in CO brightness across the disk seen in the channel maps and zeroth and eighth moment maps.

referee_caveats_inferred: No uncertainties on best-fit parameters; grid metrics only
First-moment-only fitting is degenerate between warp and radial flow
Model optimization relies on pixel thresholds tied to delta v, not statistical likelihood
Extreme warp parameters conflict with scattered light
